nodes.label: ClipPipeline Mobile Agent Guide
nodes.rationale: Mandates fetching versioned Expo docs over training memory because Expo ships breaking changes every SDK release; designs must be pulled from Google Stitch MCP first rather than invented; Stitch API key kept in gitignored .env.local and never hardcoded for security.

nodes.label: Two-Project Build Blueprint
nodes.rationale: Server owns truth and time because clients cannot be trusted with countdowns/money; money as integer minor units to avoid float errors; multi-tenant isolation resolved from token never request param to prevent cross-tenant leakage; roles assigned by business not self-selected; additive backend to avoid breaking live systems.

nodes.label: Kinetic Obsidian Design System (Connect)
nodes.rationale: Dark-first obsidian surfaces (not pitch black) give depth for layered cards; violet-to-fuchsia gradient reserved for key actions only; tabular figures prevent layout jitter during live metric refresh; 44x44px touch targets and safe-area anchors for mobile ergonomics.

nodes.label: Kinetic Obsidian Design System (Dashboard)
nodes.rationale: Same high-velocity dark-first system; surface elevation hierarchy and low-contrast micro-outlines over heavy shadows to signal technical reliability during automated syndication.

nodes.label: Connect Channels Screen
nodes.rationale: TikTok is the mandatory source account for clip import; YouTube and Instagram are syndication target destinations, expressing the post-once-everywhere pipeline.

nodes.label: Bottom Tab Navigation Bar
nodes.rationale: Persistent five-tab shell (Home, Posts, Connect, Insights, Profile) shared across all tabbed screens; active tab illuminated in primary violet with micro-indicator dot.

nodes.label: ClipPipeline (App Brand)
nodes.rationale: Brand promise 'Post once. Everywhere.' — connect channels and automate the content pipeline with encrypted token syndication and zero password sharing.

nodes.label: Syndication Leverage Banner
nodes.rationale: Quantifies the payoff of the pipeline: 3.1x cross-post boost, +210%, 1.66M extra views from a single master file via auto-syndication.
